# nobg

nobg is a free, open-source background remover that runs entirely in the
browser. Background removal happens on-device — images are never uploaded
to any server, so it is private by design and works without an account.

## Key facts

- 100% free, unlimited, no watermarks, no signup.
- Fully client-side: nothing is uploaded, ever.
- Input: PNG, JPG, WEBP (multiple files supported, batch processing).
- Output: transparent PNG, downloadable or copyable to the clipboard.
- Works offline after the first visit.

## Links

- Source code: https://github.com/vkpdeveloper/nobg
